title: Toxic
description:
S02 E07 — Alienated
Rod McCall marries a whip-smart former police officer and builds a family he believes in; when that love curdles into betrayal, his wife doesn't just leave; she dismantles his life piece by piece; he fights to survive it, but the worst comes later.

title: Shattered
description:
S02 E08 — A Very Bad Day
In 1994, a high school student holds his class hostage at gunpoint; as students, teachers and police face impending disaster, they have no idea that the worst of the day's carnage is yet to be discovered.

title: Shattered
description:
S02 E09 — Angel of Death
In 1996, Larry Schlegel visits his elderly mother at the hospital one last time before she succumbs to pneumonia; years later, police inform Schlegel that his mother's death was not at all what it seemed.

title: Diabolical
description:
S01 E01 — Mistress Roulette
Married family man Dr. Adam Frasch has a booming practice, and he loves to spend money on houses, automobiles and exotic dancers; ultimately, the doctor will reap what he sows in deceit and jealousy.

title: Diabolical
description:
S01 E02 — Lying for Love
Temptress Cathy Cousin moves in next door to devoted family man Tim Koile, wrapping him around her finger and convincing him to satisfy her every whim no matter how diabolical.

title: Diabolical
description:
S01 E08 — Accident Waiting to Happen
Single mother Rainey Morin meets soul mate Robert Kowalski who treats her like a queen; however, beneath Kowalski's kind veneer is a dark history that threatens to wreak havoc.

title: Diabolical
description:
S01 E04 — Who Lies Beneath
Valuing wealth more than love, Michelle Donohue casts aside good men before meeting Mr. Right who gives her a taste of her own medicine and sends her down a murderous path.

title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer
description:
S02 E04 — Surviving the Devil in Chicago
John Wayne Gacy is infamous for his Chicago house of horrors in the 1970s, but several courageous boys who come face-to-face with the serial killer and somehow survive step forward, ready to share their chilling story.

title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer
description:
S02 E01 — Surviving the Butcher Baker
In Anchorage, 1983, a client tortures a young sex worker, then tries to fly her to a remote location; she escapes, and her harrowing story helps police discover that this man has been hunting young women like big game across Alaska for years.

title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer
description:
S02 E03 — Surviving the Washington Woodsman
An alleged serial killer lures teenage girls into his van, then murders them in the Washington wilderness; one girl survives.

title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer
description:
S02 E06 — Surviving the Thrill Killer
An abusive lover hunts the Dallas suburbs for his ex; he unleashes his revenge on residents.

title: American Monster
description:
S10 E10 — Cabin Fever
Molly McAfee and her partner, Adam Buchanan, cherish weekends at their cabin in the woods with all the family, but someone has plans to burn everything down to take what they want.

title: American Monster
description:
S10 E05 — Enjoy the Moment While It Lasts
Mystery shrouds the Iraqi community in Michigan when a devoted father of two is found hacked to death in his home; as the search for his killer intensifies, investigators unravel a web of digital clues that reveal an evil conspiracy.

title: American Monster
description:
S10 E02 — Day Three After Murder
Divorced dad-of-three, Daniel Halseth, lives for visitations with his kids; when his teenage daughter Sierra claims that she wants to live with her dad, Daniel finds himself drawn into a web of lies and a plot that ends with a deadly house fire.

title: American Monster
description:
S09 E03 — It's Over. Move On.
Rowena Irani, a Pakistani immigrant, aspires to be a teen psychologist until a pathological love connection shatters everything.

title: American Monster
description:
S10 E08 — Keep It Hush
A home invasion in California leaves a family shattered and detectives scrambling for answers; as investigators hunt down the perps over several years, they join the dots to outline an evil plot born from greed and a need for total control.

title: American Monster
description:
S10 E03 — The Hidden Room
Carla Lewis gives her husband John money to open a medical marijuana store that sells pain relief products; spiraling costs, rumors of illegal activities and a string of infidelities eclipse the good intentions and sow the seeds for murder.

title: Homicide Hunter: Lt. Joe Kenda
description:
S09 E15 — No Good Deed
After a man is gunned down in the middle of the street, Joe Kenda must piece together a puzzle of conflicting stories and dead ends; a bloody body is discovered in a popular mall, and Kenda must make sense of the gruesome and mysterious scene.

title: Homicide Hunter: American Detective

After Charlie Kinkel goes missing in a Nevada mining town, his wife, Trayce, tries to investigate, but is shunned by locals and after a body is discovered, detectives discover Kinkel's murder was a tragic case of misplaced suspicion.

title: Welcome to Murdertown
description:
S01 E04 — A Killing in Kendrick
Donna Fontaine and her boyfriend, Fred Palahniuk, are found shot dead in a burning building in remote Kendrick, Idaho; a conspiracy of silence protects the killer until his lovers crack and confess the damning evidence needed to convict him.

title: Hometown Homicide
description:
S01 E04 — We're Watching You
Forty-year-old Rachael Anderson disappears without a trace after calling a friend about a home improvement project she'll never complete.

title: Hometown Homicide
description:
S01 E05 — This Just in
College student Jessica O'Grady vanishes one night, making locals wonder if she is kidnapped; especially since another woman disappeared a week earlier.

title: Hometown Homicide
description:

Roger Kemp finds the body of his murdered 19-year-old daughter, Ali, at the neighborhood pool where she worked; Kemp embarks on a quest to find his daughter's killer using billboards.

title: Murder in the Wicked West
description:
S01 E05 — Cowboy Conman
When cowboy Rick Godfrey goes missing in the Mojave Desert, investigators discover he's seduced and swindled many women.

title: Murder in the Wicked West
description:
S01 E04 — Cowboy Killer
Single mom Karen Petersen is enjoying a night out when a handsome cowboy charms his way into her home; he attacks her, leaving her for dead, and as more victims emerge, cops fear a serial killer is on the loose.

title: Murder in the Wicked West
description:
S01 E06 — No Honor Among Thieves
A prairie-town sheriff uncovers a drug ring that includes its most powerful law enforcement officials; to help bring them down, he calls in the FBI; just before the trial, the ring's kingpin makes a deal, and days later, he's dead.

title: No One Can Hear You Scream
description:
S01 E03 — Big Sky Mystery
When police discover Nicole Waller's SUV abandoned on a desolate Montana highway, the 31-year-old mother of three had vanished into thin air. Investigators follow a trail of lies and greed, uncovering a mystery it seems they would never solve.

title: No One Can Hear You Scream
description:
S01 E05 — Fight Like a Mother
Christi Flynn meets three shady strangers at a bar and finds herself in the fight of her life as they kidnap her and take her on a tortuous journey throughout the Arkansas forests.

title: No One Can Hear You Scream
description:
S01 E04 — The Woman Who Worked Alone
Successful real estate agent Beverly Carter heads to the country to show a rural home to some prospective buyers; when she arrives, she soon learns that this showing will be anything but routine.

title: No One Can Hear You Scream
description:
S01 E06 — Sojourn to Hell
When Laura Cowan falls on hard times, a friend of the family steps in to invite her and her two young children into his home; to her horror, Laura soon discovers that this safe haven is nothing more than a prison.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S01 E02 — Into the Woods at Midnight
Residents of a quaint village are terrified when a local innkeeper and two others are found brutally murdered; detectives must follow the depraved killer into the woods at night.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S01 E03 — I'm Not the Monster I Was
An unapologetic 14-year-old boy confesses to the murder of his best friend; twelve years later, he is back in court with a chance at a reduced sentence.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S01 E07 — I Am the Devil
A Colorado woman is missing, and her roommate may be a rare female psychopath and a skilled manipulator.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S01 E05 — I Dug a Hole and Said a Prayer
Police question a man in the disappearance of his pregnant ex-girlfriend and her young son; they discover he has a terrifying capacity for violence.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S01 E06 — I Could Hear Her Calling My Name
A girl disappears after school and her last known steps are caught on surveillance cameras; these cameras lead investigators to two dark minds that carefully plotted one of the most sinister, depraved crimes imaginable.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S02 E06 — Only if There's Something in It for Me
While being questioned in the abduction of an Anchorage barista, a young local businessman starts negotiating with investigators to reveal details of a depraved secret life as one of America's most meticulous and psychopathic serial killers.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
Now They Lay Me Down to Sleep, Part 1
A death row inmate grants a final interview weeks before his execution; after a tragic house fire in Texas, suspicion lands on a husband when the brutally murdered bodies of his family are discovered in the ashes, and he doesn't blink an eye.

title: Signs of a Psychopath

description: As Lynn Steller and her nephew Ronald lie motionless in their kitchen, Lynn's girlfriend arrives home; at first, the woman thinks this is an elaborate Halloween prank, but when she looks again, she discovers a scene that will haunt her forever.

description:
S01 E08
Three young women bound by witchcraft believe a rival casts a hex to destroy them. Desperate to break it, they try every spell they know. When fear consumes reason, one decides there's only one way to end the curse - and unleashes real-life horror.

description:
S02 E05 — Gangbuster
A series of unsolved shootings and murders across Southern Florida leave a community terrorized under the threat of an unknown gang; rookie FBI Special Agent Jessica Box makes it her mission to identify and dismantle this deadly crew.

title: FEDS
description:
S02 E06 — Hired To Kill
Over two years, a killer shoots multiple people dead in Philadelphia; the killer's identity and motive remain unclear; the FBI and a dedicated task force soon uncover that they are dealing with a real-life hitman who calls himself the Real John Wick.

title: FEDS
description:
S02 E03 — We Sell Babies
The Always Hope adoption center, run by Tara Lynn Lee, falls under suspicion of multiple families who are all left heartbroken after their adoptions fall through; the FBI begins to uncover a heartbreaking multi-state scam like no other.

title: FEDS
description:
S02 E04 — Inside Job
In Connecticut, an employee arrives at his bank with a bomb strapped to him, claiming he will die if not given money; in Tennessee, bank employees begin robbing their own banks, each claiming they have been held hostage and forced into the crime.

title: Body Cam
description:
S04 E04 — No Surrender
A car crash ignites a fireball that threatens a Maryland officer making a traffic stop; an armed burglar hides in a closet and officers must smoke him out; an officer confronts a wanted felon who pulls a gun on him.

title: Body Cam
description:
S04 E09 — Manhunt
In Colorado, a home invasion leads to a car chase and gunfight with police, resulting in a fatality; in New Mexico, a known criminal holds up a convenience store and then takes officers on a car chase.

title: Body Cam
description:
S04 E01 — Life in Ruins
SWAT tears down a house to arrest two brothers wanted for murder; a high-speed pursuit ends when a crash entangles an officer's car in live electrical cables; a DWI driver hits a goods train carrying explosive chemicals.

title: Body Cam
description:
S04 E05 — Smoking Gun
A single bullet to the chest kills a man, it looks like a murder, but the inquiry takes a turn; a high-speed pursuit turns into rescue mission as the chase ends in a fiery crash.

title: Body Cam
description:
S05 E05 — Fired Up
Police race to an armed robbery and face a hail of shotgun pellets; a gas explosion lifts the roof off an apartment building, engulfing officers in a fireball; in Georgia, a man fights for his life in a wrecked SUV.

title: Body Cam
description:
S05 E03 — Wrong Turn
In Ohio, police try to rescue a woman who is in a sinking car, which puts an officer's life in danger; in Florida, a high-speed pursuit ends in a swamp, where the suspect shoots at police and escapes.

title: See No Evil
description:
S12 E10 — The Wrong Woman
In 2017, Alisha Canales-McGuire is shot dead at her sister's house; evidence points to a targeted attack, but detectives can find no motive until CCTV and social media lead to a tangled murder plot and a twist of fate.

title: See No Evil
description:
S12 E09 — Not a Social Person
A motorist shoots dead Whitney Gray while she shops with her young kids and teenage niece; detectives follow a trail of CCTV to track down the suspect car and discover that the killer is on the run and carrying a stash of weapons.

title: See No Evil
description:
S11 E04 — The Devil's Bathtub
In 2016, father Craig Rideout is reported missing after a strange home intrusion; within hours, police find a body matching Craig's description fifty miles away; using surveillance footage and forensics, detectives unravel an unbelievable plot.

title: See No Evil
description:
S11 E02 — Tapes Don't Lie
33-year-old Michael Scott is shot dead on the streets of downtown Baltimore; detectives are in a race against time to find the gunman before he strikes again; a trail of cameras lining the city's streets and buses may lead police to the killer.

title: See No Evil
description:
S11 E07 — Toying With Us
In 2013, someone murders 35-year-old assistant manager Larry Wells in his office at Toys R Us; a disguised knife-wielding man appears on camera stalking the store; police must now follow the trail of surveillance footage to track down the killer.

title: See No Evil
description:
S12 E02 — Nowhere Girl
In 2020, 21-year-old Dioneth Lopez goes missing while on a trip to visit friends; her body turns up in the woodlands of Washington State; she is treated as a Jane Doe until detectives find surveillance footage that pieces together her final hour.

title: See No Evil
description:
S14 E07 — The Trophy Collector
In Baltimore, a killer strangles two women to death less than a week apart; investigators piece together the clues from CCTV footage from the locations of the two homicides to reveal a suspect with designs on becoming a serial killer.

title: A Body in the Basement
description:
S03 E02 — Her Last Steps
Days before Christmas, a suspected home invasion stuns a quiet Connecticut neighborhood, leaving a mother of two dead in the basement and her husband badly injured; investigators soon discover that this case may not be what it first appears.

Businesspeople John and Liz Calvert vanish in 2008 from Hilton Head, S.C.; friends, investigators and local reporters are shocked and in disbelief that a couple could disappear without a trace in such a peaceful place.

description:
S02 E06 — Unsafe Anywhere
Joel Larson is shot to death in a safe haven community for gay people in the 1990s Minneapolis; two more shootings terrorize people in the community as they realize a serial killer lives among them.

description:
S38 E13 — The Blackout Murder of Livye Lewis
A young woman is found shot in her car on the side of a road with her ex-boyfriend bloodied and disoriented nearby; the boyfriend claims he can't remember what happened.

description:
Dead Girls Don't Talk
Masked men abandon two women outside L.A. hospitals, sparking a hunt for the predator behind their deaths.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E18 — Evilness Inside My Head
An emotional 911 call comes in from a young man claiming he just found his mother and dog murdered in their home; once his interview with detectives begins, they uncover a parasitic psychopath who will do anything to get away with the crime.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E19 — That's When My Nightmare Started
A small SD card contains horrifying images and videos of a woman's murder; when someone gives it to Anchorage police, detectives come face-to-face with a sexual psychopath who has a shocking tale to tell.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E12 — The Biggest Adrenaline Rush
When detectives find an elderly woman dead after someone stuffs her in her own closet, they know they are not dealing with a normal killer. Instead, they discover the culprit is a troubled teenager with a fantasy to rape and kill.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E13 — That's What You Do With a Knife
When officers arrive at a suburban home regarding a felonious assault, they find a bloodied and lifeless woman in her minivan.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E14 — Can You Count Bullets?
Police find a woman shot to death in a car, and the prime suspect is her dangerous psychopathic boyfriend.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E15 — Everybody Believes in Bad People
A gruesome discovery in a Florida landfill reveals two young psychopathic parents with parasitic tendencies and a disturbing plan for a double murder.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E16 — Every Time Was Like Christmas
Between 1991 and 2001, several violent sexual assaults occur along I-85 between Wyoming and Utah; the cases remain cold until almost two decades later, when advancements in DNA technology lead detectives straight to a psychopathic sexual predator.

title: Signs of a Psychopath
description:
S11 E17 — He Got Such a Rush From It
Police charge a son and his wife with the murder of his father until a tip comes from a woman claiming her ex-husband and his friend admitted to the brutal killing; detectives interview the new suspects and uncover a pair of cold-blooded psychopaths.

title: The Serial Killer Connection
description:
S01 E01 — Till Death Do Us Part
Kara Robinson Chamberlain relives her escape from a serial killer while Bonnie Lou reveals what it was like to be married to him.

title: The Serial Killer Connection
description:
S01 E02 — Behind Closed Doors
Following a serial killer's military postings, Bonnie and Kara investigate murders in Maine, possible victims in San Diego, and chilling evidence in Virginia suggesting the serial killer's crimes stretched far beyond those officially known.

title: The Serial Killer Connection
description:
S01 E03 — The Final Secret
Bonnie and Kara confront the final chapter of their investigation as survivors identify a notorious serial killer, investigators revisit his known victims, and the women reflect on their search for justice after decades of unanswered questions.

title: Murder in the Heartland
description:
S06 E05 — Orders of Protection
A tip comes in from an unexpected Willard, Mo., resident that leads to the final resting ground of missing newlyweds Russell and Rebecca Porter.
